aurelianflo/pricing.note: $0.04 per wallet at depth 1, or $0.14 per wallet at depth 2 (the same as the indirect exposure add-on on wallet_screen), up to 20 wallets per call. PDF/DOCX output adds $0.05.

description: Report each wallet's exposure to sanctioned addresses from evidence: whether it is listed now, and whether its own on-chain transfers in the lookback period were sent to or received from listed addresses. Every wallet is read, including wallets that are already listed, so a listed wallet still shows its counterparties. Each wallet comes back as listed, exposed, none found in what was read, or not established, with the listed parties, transfer counts and a coverage block that says what was read and whether the read was partial. Use chains to read EVM wallets on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon or Gnosis, and depth 2 to also check counterparties of counterparties. Listed means an exact match on the OFAC SDN list. It does not predict future listings. Up to 20 wallets per call. To keep the report in your account, call saved_results_save with its screening_id. Price without an account: $0.04 per wallet at depth 1, or $0.14 per wallet at depth 2 (the same as the indirect exposure add-on on wallet_screen), up to 20 wallets per call. PDF/DOCX output adds $0.05.

address_metadata.description: Optional details per wallet. They label the rows and break ties in the order; they do not change what is found.

exposure_usd.description: Dollar exposure associated with this wallet.

label.description: A name to show for this wallet.

addresses.description: Wallet addresses to examine, up to 20.

asset.description: Optional asset or network ticker filter for the listed-now check, such as ETH, USDC, XBT or TRX. It never hides a listed address: one listed under another asset is still a match, with assetFilterMatched false in the summary. Letters and digits only, 2 to 10 characters.

chains.description: Chains to read, as EVM chain IDs (1 Ethereum, 10 Optimism, 100 Gnosis, 137 Polygon, 8453 Base, 42161 Arbitrum), "tron" or "bitcoin". When omitted, each wallet is read on the chain its address belongs to (a 0x address on Ethereum). Each wallet is read only on the listed chains that can hold its address; a wallet that none of them can hold is reported as not established.

depth.description: 1 (default) reads each wallet's direct counterparties. 2 also follows the largest counterparties to their own counterparties. Depth 2 takes three of an account's daily exposure reads per wallet instead of one, and has a higher price without an account.

lookback_days.description: How far back to read transfers, in days. Default 180.

output_format.description: json (default) for the structured result, or pdf/docx to also get a generated report artifact.

response_detail.description: summary (default) returns a short text summary for you to read, with the full result in structuredContent. full returns the full JSON as text as well.

name: compliance_exposure_report

outputSchema.description: Structured exposure report: one row per wallet with its finding, evidence and coverage.

accepts.description: Present when payment is needed: the x402 payment requirements to sign.

artifacts.description: Artifact rendering hints keyed by format.

bucket.description: Present when a daily limit was reached: the limit that was reached.

data.description: Result: the query, summary counts, one row per wallet, and the limitations.

limitations.description: What the report does not show.

list_context.description: OFAC's recent pace of additions, for context.

query.description: The query as run, including depth and chains.

sourceFreshness.description: The sanctions list that was checked and when it was published.

summary.description: Counts of wallets listed now, with listed counterparties, none found and not established, and the number of partial reads.

wallets.description: One row per wallet, in review order.

coverage.description: What was read for this wallet. A field that was not examined is null and reason says why.

chains.description: Chains whose transfers were read; null when none were.

complete.description: True when every chain was read back to the start of the lookback period.

lookbackDays.description: Days of history the read was meant to cover.

pagesRead.description: Indexer pages read; null when not known.

reason.description: Why a field above is null.

transfersExamined.description: Transfers examined; null when not examined.

evidence.description: Listed counterparties and transfer counts. Counts are null when the wallet was not read.

finding.description: One-line summary of the finding. Says partial read when the read was not complete.

label.description: Label supplied in address_metadata, if any.

listed_now.description: True when the wallet is an exact match on the OFAC SDN list.

scope.description: Chains, period and depth that were examined.

error.description: Machine-readable error code when the tool fails.

limit.description: Present when a daily limit was reached: the daily limit.

output.description: The generated PDF or DOCX when output_format asks for one.

payer.description: Present when a payment was refused: the paying address.

price.description: Present when payment is needed: the price of the call without an account.

remaining.description: Present when a daily limit was reached: how much was left.

anyOf.description: Report document with summary, metrics and tables.

resetsAt.description: Present when a daily limit was reached: when it resets (ISO 8601).

retryAfterSeconds.description: Present when the account made too many calls: seconds to wait.

support.description: Present on some errors: where to get help.

used.description: Present when a daily limit was reached: how much of it was used today.

x402Version.description: Present when payment is needed: the x402 protocol version.

title: Exposure Report
